name: Tianjin Guoan Mengguli New Materials Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin Guoan Mengguli New Materials Science & Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries in China and internationally. The company offers high-voltage lithium cobalt oxide, medium-nickel ternary materials, high-nickel ternary materials, and frontier materials. Its products are used in consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, electric two-wheeled vehicles, power tools, robots, smart devices, low-altitude aircraft, UPS power supplies, and BBU power supply applications. Tianjin Guoan Mengguli New Materials Science & Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Tianjin, China.
